说明：目前上传的是低画质水印版。等漫画完结后，我会再替换成高清原图。
我一直觉得，好的作品不应该只有一部分人能看到，所以才选择分享出来。但我也不想伤害作者，毕竟我真的很喜欢他的画风和画技。
我知道有些人因为经济原因或其他原因，本来也很难支持作者，所以我才先上传低画质版本。真正想看高清版的人，像我一样，应该还是会选择支持作者、去看正版。等这部作品完结、作者开始新作品后，我再上传高清版，这样应该不会影响他的收入。
感谢你看到这里，祝你今天愉快！

Note: This will be uploaded in lower quality and with a watermark for now. Once the comic ends, I will replace it with the full-quality images.
I’ve always thought media shouldn’t be limited, which is why I’m sharing this. At the same time, I don’t want to hurt the artist, as I really appreciate their skill and art.
I understand that people who can’t afford to support them, or can’t for other reasons, most likely wouldn’t support them anyway, which is why I’m uploading it like this for now. Those who care about the full-quality version (like me) may still choose to support the artist to get the original. So when the comic ends and they start a new project, I will upload the full quality so I don’t affect their revenue.
Thanks for reading this, and have a nice day!
